def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find full divider rows and columns.
    div_rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    div_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    # Retain only lines whose color occurs as a full row/column.
    div_rows = [r for r in div_rows if grid[r][0] != grid[0][0] or r != 0]
    div_cols = [c for c in div_cols if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    # Here the divider color is the color of the full separator row/column.
    row_lines = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    rsep = row_lines[0] if row_lines else None
    csep = col_lines[0] if col_lines else None

    r0, r1 = (0, rsep) if rsep is not None else (0, h)
    c0, c1 = (0, csep) if csep is not None else (0, w)
    tile = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    th, tw = len(tile), len(tile[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h):
        if rsep is not None and r == rsep:
            continue
        for c in range(w):
            if csep is not None and c == csep:
                continue
            out[r][c] = tile[r % th][c % tw]
    return out
